verdict.rationale: Skyvern offers no explicit no-training policy or opt-out. Its documented self-hosted mode runs entirely on your own servers and browsers with your own LLM API keys, which keeps data off Skyvern's infrastructure as a workaround. Whether that data is used for training then depends on your own LLM provider's terms. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that Skyvern does not train on customer data, a training opt-out control for the Cloud product, contractual or DPA terms covering model training, and independent corroboration.
